info.name: Marketplace Nigeria API Documentation
info.description: Complete REST API documentation for Marketplace Nigeria platform. This API allows you to manage adverts, users, messages, payments, and more.

item.name: Advert Statistics
item.description: APIs for retrieving advertisement statistics, counts, and filtering

request.description:
Returns the total count of active adverts based on various filters.
All filters are optional and can be combined.

Returns the count of active adverts grouped by Nigerian states.
Results are ordered by state with the most adverts first.

item.name: Get advert count filtered by verified sellers

request.description:
Returns the count of adverts from verified or unverified sellers.
Useful for showing marketplace trust metrics.

Returns a list of brands with their active advert counts.
Can be filtered by category or sub-category. Only returns brands with at least one active advert.

variable.description: The ID of the device token.

POST /api/login

Social Login - Mobile sends provider token
POST /api/auth/social

request.description:
Mobile app gets token from provider (Google/Facebook SDK)
then sends it to this endpoint for verification

item.name:

GET /api/auth/{provider}/redirect

Social Login Callback - For WebView flow
GET /api/auth/{provider}/callback

Get all adverts with pagination and categorized sections
GET /api/adverts

Get all categories with counts
GET /api/categories

Apply for a job advert
POST /api/adverts/{id}/apply

item.name: Authenticate the request for channel access.
User Statistics
item.description: APIs for retrieving user statistics, feedback, and notifications

request.description:
Returns comprehensive statistics for the currently authenticated user including
followers count, unread messages, notifications, and feedback ratings.
Returns the count of unread messages for the authenticated user.

Retrieves notifications for the authenticated user with pagination support.
Returns both the notifications list and unread count.
Retrieves the total number of followers for a specific user.

Retrieves feedback averages and rating labels for a specific user.
Includes overall rating, satisfaction, reliability, and friendliness scores.
